title: Keycloak: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling (CWE-770) during Java object deserialization in Google…
description: CVE-2026-102554 is a high-severity vulnerability in Keycloak related to allocation of resources without limits or throttling during Java object deserialization in Google Guava versions 4. This flaw can lead to excessive resource consumption. Fixed versions 26.4.2-r4 and 26.7.5-r2 address this issue.
